greetings: Hello and welcome to my portfolio!
title: I'm Nahuel,
introduction1: I'm Nahuel Uliassi Pirchio, a software developer from Buenos Aires, Argentina. I build practical web applications with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and modern backend tools.
introduction2: My strongest work sits between product behavior and implementation: user-facing flows, internal tools, APIs, authentication, data access, deployment, and maintainable application structure.
introduction3: My latest experience also included cross-platform desktop work, but my main focus is web product development: understanding the context, shaping the solution, writing the code, improving the experience, and shipping software that is useful in real workflows.
